title: DoughUtils
description: A plugin for all Doughmination works
body:
**DoughUtils is a unified server plugin suite built for the Doughmination network!**

It combines everything the server needs into a single jar — travel commands, base protection, vein mining, roleplay emotes, moderation tools, jail, a Discord whitelist sync bot, End dragon event tracking, and more — so there's no juggling a stack of separate plugins.

**Highlights include:**
- 🏠 **Base system** — set, name, protect, and trust players at your base, with optional base flight
- ⛏️ **Vein miner** — toggleable ore and tree vein mining with Fortune and XP support
- 🚔 **Moderation** — ban, jail, and inventory inspection tools built in
- 🔗 **WingSync** — Discord bot that syncs your whitelist and bans automatically
- 🐉 **End stats** — tracks dragon event participation, kill credits, and loot roles
- ✨ **Quality of life** — `/back`, `/rtp`, `/tpa`, `/spawn`, `/echest`, `/vchest`, `/craft`, `/tps`, `/seen`, `/playtime`, and more

**Installation is simple** — drop it into your server's `plugins` folder, configure `config.yml` with your Discord bot token and any WingSync settings, restart, and everything is ready to go.

> ⚠️ Requires Paper 1.21.1+

*Built for [Doughmination](https://modding.doughmination.win)*
